verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core Focus Time and Habits features are explicitly documented as AI-defended blocks that flex/reschedule around conflicts rather than being dropped (reclaim-docs-1, reclaim-docs-30, reclaim-docs-31, reclaim-docs-34), reinforced by priority-based auto-scheduling (reclaim-docs-33) and locking behavior. Community testimonials corroborate real-world use of habit/commitment defense (reclaim-comm-1, reclaim-comm-3, reclaim-comm-10). Missing for 10: independent long-term reliability data or edge-case testing showing how conflicts are resolved in practice beyond vendor docs and a few anecdotes.
